annotations.title: An Instagram Story’s numbers, kept past its 24 hours

description: An Instagram Story’s numbers: reach, views, replies, shares, link clicks, profile visits, follows, and navigation (forward, back, next story, exit). Meta keeps them for 24 hours, so Hermoso reads every live Story on a schedule, including ones posted from the phone, and they stay readable here after the Story ends. Pass storyId for one, or nothing for the recent ones. `state` says what is known: numbers, below_minimum (Meta withholds them under 5 viewers), not_captured (it ended before a read), or why a read failed; none of those means zero. Meta returns 0 replies for Stories created in Europe and Japan, and the answer says so. Link clicks need a Facebook-login connection. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: one Instagram account: an @handle or id

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.
